2034-3129-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4050-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4050-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

803-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

1011-2728-3967-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-3967-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-3967-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3184-4766-6798--190.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot trigger.
Repeat.

940-3713-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Arcane Teachings by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or North Pole Patrol

1432-7014-7786.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-4785.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4050-4316-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-4316-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1543-2061-2740-4231-6717.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication and Tamiyo's Journal trigger.
Resolve the Extravagant Replication trigger, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Resolve the Tamiyo's Journal trigger, creating three Clue, Food and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers nine times, putting nine loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication and Tamiyo's Journal trigger.
Resolve the Extravagant Replication trigger, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Resolve the Tamiyo's Journal trigger, creating nine Clue, Food and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers 27 times, putting 27 loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 8 each turn.
1543-2061-2740-4231-6717.notes: You can continually make more Academy Manufactors each turn, which will progressively give you more Clues, Foods and Treasures each turn.

1636-2921-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-2921-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

2757-4222-6702.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping an Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

1231-2034-4826-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

222-527-969-2292.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1846-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1846-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1846-4826-5702-5954.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 4.

654-1409-1671-2895.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
654-1409-1671-2895.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

275-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1624-1927-3754.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Soulgorger Orgg by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Soulgorger Orgg enters the battlefield, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2648-5003-5231.description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Triniform to Thermopod to add {R}.
Phyrexian Triniform and Nim Deathmantle both trigger.
Resolve Phyrexian Triniform's ability first, creating three Golem artifact creatures.
Sacrifice all three Golems to Thermopod to add 3 {R} total.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying the {4} to return Phyrexian Triniform to the battlefield with Nim Deathmantle equipped.
Repeat for infinite ETB and LTB.
